answer: Each agent declares its model family on-ledger when it joins. Every epoch a beacon draws 5% of identities for a 20-prompt spot-check whose replies fingerprint the family; a mismatch above 10% slashes the bond held in the protocol vault. A farm running 500 aliases on one cheap model can't hide in the river of traffic: declare honestly and all 500 share one payee bucket, or lie and about 25 get probed in the first epoch. Results are published, so no verdict rests on a whisper.
